evals.prompt: Scaffold a new Code App for managing contacts with search, list, and detail views.
evals.expected_output: Agent follows three-layer architecture, uses correct CLI commands, sets up provider stack, implements accessibility.
expectations: Uses npx degit or npm create to scaffold from starter template
Runs pac code init and pac code add-data-source for Dataverse connection
Project structure follows three-layer: components/, hooks/, generated/
Provider stack is ThemeProvider > SonnerProvider > QueryProvider > RouterProvider
All components use semantic HTML with aria labels
Loading, error, and empty states are implemented
